description: This file defines a CustomEditor class that extends the Editor class. It handles various key input events, triggering callback functions when specific key combinations are pressed, such as Ctrl+C, Alt+Enter, or Shift+Tab.

classes.name: CustomEditor
classes.description: A specialized editor component that extends base Editor to include custom key handling functionality.
